reason: Attempt 7 scored 76.6%. Specific loan and card products were still displaced by generic reporting categories, and some education loans became personal loans. Clarify the classification order rather than add further exceptions.
instruction: Choose exactly one label by resolving the most specific financial product supported by the narrative. First distinguish loans: home financing or mortgage servicing is Mortgage; education borrowing, including private education loans and tuition financing, is Student loan; vehicle-purchase financing, leasing, or repossession is Vehicle loan or lease; other personal/installment borrowing, payday borrowing, cash advances, and title-secured cash loans are Payday loan, title loan, personal loan, or advance loan. Next distinguish cards: borrowing through a card, billing, interest, rewards, or credit-card purchase disputes is Credit card; gift, stored-value, reloadable, payroll, or benefit cards are Prepaid card. For remaining cases, bank deposit-account access, balances, fees, checks, and debit-card servicing are Checking or savings account; a disputed remittance, wire, transfer execution, payment processor, wallet, or virtual-currency service is Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service. A complaint whose respondent acts as a collector or enforces a debt is Debt collection. A complaint about a credit bureau or consumer-reporting service itself is Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports. Apply these distinctions to the product or service under dispute, not to a background product, incidental payment destination, copied statute, or requested report deletion.
